template_data.headline_html: Five things to check before renewal.

items.title: Exact expiration date
items.sub: Find it, calendar it 60 days out — don't rely on memory

items.title: NAICS codes reviewed
items.sub: Match codes to what you're actually bidding and winning now

items.title: Banking details current
items.sub: Changed accounts or banks? Update before the next award

items.title: Certifications verified
items.sub: WOSB, SDVOSB, 8(a), HUBZone — confirm each flag is active

items.title: E-Verify status
items.sub: Required for federal contractors; lapsed = silent disqualifier
